periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Near-vertical orientation, approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal muzzle-to-ear axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated vertical oval with a high aspect ratio, where height significantly exceeds width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering with the lowest extremity forming a sharp point significantly below the geometric center.
